assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a 3×3 transparent atlas of seven small original science images for first-grade lesson. Exactly seven occupied cells in row-major order R1C1 through R3C1. Leave R3C2 and R3C3 entirely transparent, as well as all margins. Leave every cell with at least 15% fully transparent margins. No grids, cards, outer backgrounds, labels, digits, words, lines suggesting writing, arrows, ticks, checkmarks or X marks. Style: fine paper grain, matte gouache, clean cut-paper forms, warm cream, soft seafoam, apricot and lavender. Clear equal-sized quiz choices with authentic spatial clues. Keep three seafoam backpack pictures balanced in size and draw one identical rigid plain lilac art board in each. Keep three stamp pictures balanced in size and use one identical solid purple square stamp, visibly only one per image.
R1C1: new unfamiliar seafoam backpack close-up of its shallow horizontal front zipper pocket, with a large rigid plain lilac rectangular board beside the zip opening. Clearly show the board is much wider than that pocket. No hand needed, board fully visible.
R1C2: exactly the same seafoam backpack and board, camera at same distance. Show the broad main opening wide enough, board lying horizontally inside it with both ends and roomy depth visible. No cropped board or extra items.
R1C3: exactly the same seafoam backpack and rigid board, camera at same distance. Board held beside the narrow outside mesh bottle pocket, with board visibly much wider than that narrow mesh opening. Show recognizable net texture, no bottle.
R2C1: one original clay-colored soft utility pouch in a shallow cutaway. A single squat purple square stamp is exposed upright in a shallow open pocket near the top, and a child's fingers are visibly poised above to lift it. No stamp markings.
R2C2: same pouch and exactly same purple square stamp; a clear cutaway view shows it in the deep pocket, partially hidden under a large yellow cloth. No hand retrieving it. Exposed purple area remains easy to identify.
R2C3: that same purple stamp visibly trapped under the edge of a stack of two blank notebooks, its purple handle partially exposed. No second stamp and no hand. Keep a suggestion of the same clay pouch beside it if space allows but do not hide the cause.
R3C1: one small original home desk storyboard, exactly three small illustrated scenes side by side in one single cell, each showing the same safe block and short cloth piece. Left: a child's hand making a simple drawing of their starting positions on blank paper, no text. Center: adult and child hands moving those exact objects into two separated compartments. Right: child hand reaching for one object in its visible compartment. No extra panels, visible address or writing.
